explanation: Latin medius means middle and terra land: to the Romans the sea lay amid Europe, Africa and Asia. They also called it Mare Nostrum, our sea.

claims.text: 'Mediterranean' comes from Latin medius, 'middle', and terra, 'land'.
The name does not mean calm blue water, sea of islands or southern sea.
The Mediterranean Sea lies between Europe, Africa and Asia.
The Romans also called the Mediterranean Mare Nostrum, 'our sea'.
